literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: MPV 刺激导致免疫可溶性介质水平发生显着变化,包括对 抗病毒药物 防御和免疫调节至关重要的趋化因子和细胞因子的减少。治疗 与 3F2 联合使用可显着提高 CCL2、CXCL8、IFN-γ、IL-12(p40)、IL-15、IL-5 和必需生长因子(如 VEGF 和 NGF-β)的水平。 [10.1007/s00011-026-02387-3]

在确诊的 猴痘 病例(G1)中,感染集中在男性(97.7%)、19至59岁的成年人(98.8%)、贝伦居民(76.7%)、受过高等教育的人(53.5%)以及自称同性恋(73.3%)或双性恋(12.8%)取向的人中。发热(81.4%)和局部生殖器病变(G1 为 43.0%,G2 为 6.2%)是主要临床表现。亲密性接触是主要的暴露途径(65.1%)。在 G1 期观察到 HIV 合并感染的比例很高(54.7%),其中 23.3% 的人在接到通知时表现出活动性 STI,主要是梅毒(16.3%)。临床治疗以门诊为主,住院率7.0%,有效确诊病例治愈率96.5%。 [10.1007/s15010-026-03022-3]

这些 hKG 的功能富集分析揭示了 猴痘 感染的关键致病过程,包括生物过程、分子功能、细胞成分和 KEGG 途径。此外,前三种复合物(ALB-特考韦瑞、CDH1-Maraviroc 和 PPARG-Beclabuvir)的 100 ns 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟显示出强大的结合稳定性,并得到 RMSD、RMSF 和 MM-GBSA 结果的支持。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014797]
流行病学数据显示,人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、沙眼衣原体、单纯疱疹病毒、梅毒等性传播感染经常与 猴痘 感染相关,这凸显了性接触在 猴痘 感染中的作用。 [10.1097/olq.0000000000002438]
我们的研究结果表明,研究人群与 传播 的全球趋势一致,几乎完全在男男性行为者群体中,大多数病例由 C 谱系病毒以及其他 8 个亚谱系病毒引起。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag288]

Functional enrichment analysis of these hKGs revealed critical pathogenic processes of MPOX infection, including biological processes, molecular functions, cellular components, and KEGG pathways. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014797]

Epidemiological data reveal that STIs such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Chlamydia trachomatis, herpes simplex virus, syphilis have been frequently associated with mpox infection highlighting the role of sexual contact in its transmission. [10.1097/olq.0000000000002438]

brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.

news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 据南非政府通讯社报道,南非发现了四起新的 猴痘 病例。 [news-a5e3cf968ea7280a]
猴痘 暴发,包括进化枝 I 和进化枝 II,正在进行中。最近的暴发主要通过亲密或性接触传播,有些病例涉及家庭传播。CDC 报告称,进化枝 I 暴发 已归属于 Ib 亚进化枝,而进化枝 II 暴发 自 2022 年以来一直在持续存在。 [news-a0ad317dd700afa5]
自 2023 年底以来,I 型猴痘 暴发 已在中非和东非发生,西欧国家较新的 暴发 可能与正在发生的 暴发 有关。在美国,自 2026 年 3 月以来,分支 I 猴痘病例有所增加,在多个司法管辖区观察到持续分支 Ib 传播 的转变。 [news-b5c65cab18ffd6be]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Four new mpox cases identified in South Africa, reported by the South African Government News Agency. [news-a5e3cf968ea7280a]

Monkeypox outbreaks, including both clade I and clade II, are ongoing. Recent outbreaks have primarily spread through intimate or sexual contact, with some cases involving household transmission. [news-a0ad317dd700afa5]

Outbreaks of clade I monkeypox have occurred in Central and Eastern Africa since late 2023, with newer outbreaks in Western European countries likely related to this ongoing outbreak. [news-b5c65cab18ffd6be]

A mpox outbreak was declared in Kasaï province on 16 September 2026. By 1 October 2026, 1,017 cases and more than 24 deaths had been reported across all 18 health zones. The outbreak was reported as ongoing, with national health authorities deploying Rapid Intervention Teams to Tshikapa on 4 October 2026. [news-60e3d5ebddec368a]

A computational study published in PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases by Sabkat Mahmud, Alvira Ajadee, and colleagues mapped the mechanisms of monkeypox virus and identified potential repurposed drugs for its treatment. This is a research event, not an outbreak, and is confirmed based on the study's findings. [news-5959bc3fe3a6ee2f]

papers.title: Efficacy of Tecovirimat for the Treatment of Mpox Virus Infection in Humans: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
papers.abstract: Tecovirimat has been widely used for the treatment of mpox despite limited evidence supporting its efficacy. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for this purpose. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 5, 2026 for RCTs comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care in patients with laboratory-confirmed mpox. Primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions, clinical resolution by day 28-29, and 28-day all-cause mortality. Hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random-effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman adjustment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Two low-risk-of-bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included. Tecovirimat did not shorten the time to clinical resolution of skin lesions compared with placebo (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52-2.31, GRADE: moderate) or increase the lesion resolution by day 28-29 (RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.92-1.08, GRADE: high). No statistical heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 0% for both outcomes). Mortality at day 28 was rare in both trials, precluding meta-analysis. Virological clearance, pain-related outcomes, and serious adverse events were also comparable between treatment groups. In conclusion, current randomized evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use to accelerate clinical recovery or improve mortality rates in patients with mpox, while further evidence is needed to determine whether selected high-risk populations may benefit from antiviral therapy.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for treating mpox virus infection in humans. Two low-risk-of-bias RCTs involving 941 participants were analyzed, focusing on clinical outcomes such as time to skin lesion resolution and 28-day mortality. papers.title_zh: 特考韦瑞 对人类 猴痘病毒 感染的 治疗 的功效:随机对照试验的系统回顾和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: Tecovirimat has been widely used for the treatment of mpox despite limited evidence supporting its efficacy. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for this purpose. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 5, 2026 for RCTs comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care in patients with laboratory-confirmed mpox. Primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions, clinical resolution by day 28-29, and 28-day all-cause mortality. Hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random-effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman adjustment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Two low-risk-of-bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included. Tecovirimat did not shorten the time to clinical resolution of skin lesions compared with placebo (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52-2.31, GRADE: moderate) or increase the lesion resolution by day 28-29 (RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.92-1.08, GRADE: high). No statistical heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 0% for both outcomes). Mortality at day 28 was rare in both trials, precluding meta-analysis. Virological clearance, pain-related outcomes, and serious adverse events were also comparable between treatment groups. In conclusion, current randomized evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use to accelerate clinical recovery or improve mortality rates in patients with mpox, while further evidence is needed to determine whether selected high-risk populations may benefit from antiviral therapy.

papers.title: Mpox and sexually transmitted infections: syndemic drivers of transmission and disease outcomes-A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: The worldwide outbreak of mpox (formerly monkeypox) in 2022 emerged as a public health emergency posing greater threat to persons with sexually transmitted infections (STIs). This outbreak featured an increase in overlap between mpox and STIs reflecting evolving transmission dynamics in sexual networks. Epidemiological data reveal that STIs such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Chlamydia trachomatis , herpes simplex virus, syphilis have been frequently associated with mpox infection highlighting the role of sexual contact in its transmission. A narrative review was conducted using PubMed and Google Scholar to identify relevant literature published between 2008 and 2026, focusing on mpox, STIs, co-infections, and pregnancy outcomes. Evidence suggests that biological, behavioural and structural factors may interact to influence mpox transmission and clinical outcomes. STI co-infection may be associated with mucosal invasion and immune modulation plausibly affecting disease progression, however direct mechanistic evidence remains limited. Although mpox infection has majorly affected gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM), its severity in women particularly during pregnancy raises concerns regarding vertical transmission and maternal and neonatal complications. This review highlights current evidence on mpox-STI co-infections, and applies a syndemic framework to interpret their co-occurrence within biological, behavioural and structural contexts. While this perspective provides understanding regarding transmission patterns, further research is needed to establish the extent of these interactions. Recognizing these factors is important for screening, early diagnosis and management strategies to mitigate future outbreaks and impact of mpox. Summary: This narrative review on mpox and STI co-infections explores syndemic interactions, transmission dynamics and implications for disease outcomes and public health management

papers.title_zh: 猴痘 和性传播感染:猴痘 的并发流行病驱动因素和疾病结果 - 叙述性评论
papers.source_body_en: The worldwide outbreak of mpox (formerly monkeypox) in 2022 emerged as a public health emergency posing greater threat to persons with sexually transmitted infections (STIs). This outbreak featured an increase in overlap between mpox and STIs reflecting evolving transmission dynamics in sexual networks. Epidemiological data reveal that STIs such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Chlamydia trachomatis , herpes simplex virus, syphilis have been frequently associated with mpox infection highlighting the role of sexual contact in its transmission. A narrative review was conducted using PubMed and Google Scholar to identify relevant literature published between 2008 and 2026, focusing on mpox, STIs, co-infections, and pregnancy outcomes. Evidence suggests that biological, behavioural and structural factors may interact to influence mpox transmission and clinical outcomes. STI co-infection may be associated with mucosal invasion and immune modulation plausibly affecting disease progression, however direct mechanistic evidence remains limited. Although mpox infection has majorly affected gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM), its severity in women particularly during pregnancy raises concerns regarding vertical transmission and maternal and neonatal complications. This review highlights current evidence on mpox-STI co-infections, and applies a syndemic framework to interpret their co-occurrence within biological, behavioural and structural contexts. While this perspective provides understanding regarding transmission patterns, further research is needed to establish the extent of these interactions. Recognizing these factors is important for screening, early diagnosis and management strategies to mitigate future outbreaks and impact of mpox. Summary: This narrative review on mpox and STI co-infections explores syndemic interactions, transmission dynamics and implications for disease outcomes and public health management
papers.abstract_zh: 2022 年全球爆发的 猴痘(原猴痘)暴发 成为突发公共卫生事件,对性传播感染 (STI) 患者构成更大威胁。该 暴发 的特点是 猴痘 和 STI 之间的重叠增加,反映了性网络中不断变化的 传播 动态。流行病学数据显示,人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、沙眼衣原体、单纯疱疹病毒、梅毒等性传播感染经常与 猴痘 感染相关,这凸显了性接触在 猴痘 感染中的作用。使用 PubMed 和 Google Scholar 进行叙述性回顾,以确定 2008 年至 2026 年期间发表的相关文献,重点关注 猴痘、性传播感染、合并感染和妊娠结局。有证据表明,生物、行为和结构因素可能相互作用,影响 猴痘 传播 和临床结果。STI 合并感染可能与粘膜侵袭和免疫调节有关,可能影响疾病进展,但直接的机制证据仍然有限。尽管 猴痘 感染主要影响同性恋、双性恋和其他男男性行为者 (GBMSM),但其在女性中尤其是怀孕期间的严重程度引起了对垂直 传播 以及孕产妇和新生儿并发症的担忧。本综述重点介绍了 猴痘-STI 合并感染的当前证据,并应用流行病框架来解释它们在生物、行为和结构背景下的共存。虽然这个观点提供了对 传播 模式的理解,但需要进一步研究来确定这些相互作用的程度。认识到这些因素对于筛查、早期 诊断 和减轻未来 暴发 和 猴痘 影响的管理策略非常重要。摘要:这篇关于 猴痘 和 STI 合并感染的叙述性综述探讨了流行病相互作用、猴痘 动态以及对疾病结果和公共卫生管理的影响

papers.title: Epidemiological and sociodemographic profile of Mpox in Brazilian Amazon: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The Mpox outbreak was characterized by viral transmission within sexual networks and atypical clinical presentations, requiring regional epidemiological evaluations. This study aimed to describe the sociodemographic profile, temporal notification trends, and clinical characteristics of suspected and confirmed Mpox cases in Pará, Brazilian Amazon (2022-2025). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Observational, cross-sectional, and analytical study based on the Notifiable Diseases Information System (SINAN) between March 2022 and December 2025, adhering to STROBE guidelines. The sample (N = 296) was stratified into confirmed Mpox cases (G1; n = 86) and ruled-out cases (G2; n = 210). Associations were evaluated using Pearson's Chi-square test (for expected cell counts ≥ 5) or Fisher's exact test (for expected counts < 5), with significance set at p < 0.05 in SPSS v.26.0. RESULTS: In G1, infection was concentrated among men (97.7%), cisgender men (96.5%), adults aged 19 to 59 years (98.8%), residents of Belém (76.7%), individuals with tertiary education (53.5%), and those reporting homosexual (73.3%) or bisexual (12.8%) orientation (p < 0.001). Clinically, fever (81.4%; p < 0.001) and localized genital lesions (43.0% in G1 vs. 6.2% in G2; p < 0.001) were the primary presentations. Intimate sexual contact was the primary probable exposure pathway (65.1%; p < 0.001). A high proportion of HIV coinfection was observed in G1 (54.7%), with complete reporting overlap with immunosuppression status, alongside 23.3% presenting an active STI at notification (p < 0.001), predominantly active syphilis (16.3%). Clinical management was predominantly outpatient (7.0% hospitalization rate; p = 0.261), with a 96.5% cure rate among valid confirmed cases. No Mpox-attributed deaths occurred among confirmed cases, though all-cause mortality in G1 was 2.3% (n = 2). CONCLUSION: Mpox cases in Pará were concentrated in the state capital, associated with intimate sexual contact networks among young adults, and characterized by high coinfection frequencies with HIV and syphilis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要了解巴西亚马逊地区 猴痘 的流行病学和社会人口学概况,因为 暴发 显示性网络中的病毒 传播 和非典型的临床表现。该研究旨在描述该地区 猴痘 病例的人口统计学和临床​​特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究使用了 2022 年 3 月至 2025 年 12 月期间来自法定疾病信息系统 (SINAN) 的数据。样本包括 296 例病例,分为确诊 猴痘 病例(G1;n = 86)和排除病例(G2;n = 210)。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究是观察性和分析性的,遵循 STROBE 指南。使用 Pearson 卡方检验和 Fisher 精确检验等统计检验评估关联性,在 SPSS v.26.0 中将显着性设置为 p < 0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 在确诊的 猴痘 病例(G1)中,感染集中在男性(97.7%)、19至59岁的成年人(98.8%)、贝伦居民(76.7%)、受过高等教育的人(53.5%)以及自称同性恋(73.3%)或双性恋(12.8%)取向的人中。发热(81.4%)和局部生殖器病变(G1 为 43.0%,G2 为 6.2%)是主要临床表现。亲密性接触是主要的暴露途径(65.1%)。在 G1 期观察到 HIV 合并感染的比例很高(54.7%),其中 23.3% 的人在接到通知时表现出活动性 STI,主要是梅毒(16.3%)。临床治疗以门诊为主,住院率7.0%,有效确诊病例治愈率96.5%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,帕拉州的 猴痘 病例集中在州首府,与年轻人之间的亲密性接触网络有关。他们注意到 HIV 和梅毒的双重感染频率很高,强调了 猴痘 与该人群中这些疾病之间的新关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为巴西亚马逊地区的针对性 监测 和预防策略提供了信息,特别关注高风险群体,例如男男性行为者和艾滋病毒感染者。他们还强调需要采取综合方法来解决同时发生的性传播感染问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于横截面设计,这限制了因果推断。样本量相对较小,且数据来源于通知系统,可能会引入报告偏差。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要了解巴西亚马逊地区 猴痘 的流行病学和社会人口学概况,因为 暴发 显示性网络中的病毒 传播 和非典型的临床表现。该研究旨在描述该地区 猴痘 病例的人口统计学和临床​​特征。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究使用了 2022 年 3 月至 2025 年 12 月期间来自法定疾病信息系统 (SINAN) 的数据。样本包括 296 例病例,分为确诊 猴痘 病例(G1;n = 86)和排除病例(G2;n = 210)。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究是观察性和分析性的,遵循 STROBE 指南。使用 Pearson 卡方检验和 Fisher 精确检验等统计检验评估关联性,在 SPSS v.26.0 中将显着性设置为 p < 0.05。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在确诊的 猴痘 病例(G1)中,感染集中在男性(97.7%)、19至59岁的成年人(98.8%)、贝伦居民(76.7%)、受过高等教育的人(53.5%)以及自称同性恋(73.3%)或双性恋(12.8%)取向的人中。发热(81.4%)和局部生殖器病变(G1 为 43.0%,G2 为 6.2%)是主要临床表现。亲密性接触是主要的暴露途径(65.1%)。在 G1 期观察到 HIV 合并感染的比例很高(54.7%),其中 23.3% 的人在接到通知时表现出活动性 STI,主要是梅毒(16.3%)。临床治疗以门诊为主,住院率7.0%,有效确诊病例治愈率96.5%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,帕拉州的 猴痘 病例集中在州首府,与年轻人之间的亲密性接触网络有关。他们注意到 HIV 和梅毒的双重感染频率很高,强调了 猴痘 与该人群中这些疾病之间的新关联。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为巴西亚马逊地区的针对性 监测 和预防策略提供了信息,特别关注高风险群体,例如男男性行为者和艾滋病毒感染者。他们还强调需要采取综合方法来解决同时发生的性传播感染问题。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于横截面设计,这限制了因果推断。样本量相对较小,且数据来源于通知系统,可能会引入报告偏差。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Disclosing pathogenic processes of monkeypox (MPOX) and drug repurposing through host-transcriptomics analysis
papers.abstract: Monkeypox (MPOX) virus infection outbreak in Africa in 2022 was initially considered a neglected tropical disease (NTD). Now it is recognized as a global health problem. The recent global spread has emphasized the need for increased attention to combat MPOX. Although there are some vaccines against MPOX, most people worldwide are still not vaccinated due to their unawareness or unavailability. However, so far, there is no approved drug against MPOX yet. Therefore, effective drugs against MPOX are also essential. This study attempted to disclose pathogenic processes and therapeutic strategies of MPOX based on MPOX-associated host key-genes (hKGs). At first, three transcriptomic profile datasets were analyzed, identifying 166 common host differentially expressed genes (hDEGs) between MPOX patients and control groups, comprising 75 upregulated and 91 downregulated hDEGs. Subsequently, six top-ranked host key genes (hKGs): ALB, HSP90AA1, CDH1, PTPRC, IGF1, and ABL1, were identified as potential MPOX-causing genes through protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis. Functional enrichment analysis of these hKGs revealed critical pathogenic processes of MPOX infection, including biological processes, molecular functions, cellular components, and KEGG pathways. Regulatory network analysis involving transcription factors and miRNAs provided further insights into disease mechanisms. Based on molecular docking analysis, five top-ranked drug molecules Tecovirimat, Beclabuvir, Maraviroc, Raltegravir, and Brincidofovir were identified as potential repurposable therapeutics against MPOX. ADME/T and drug-likeness evaluations confirmed favorable pharmacokinetic properties for these candidates. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the top three complexes (ALB-Tecovirimat, CDH1-Maraviroc, and PPARG-Beclabuvir) demonstrated strong binding stability, supported by RMSD, RMSF, and MM-GBSA results. Therefore, the results provided in this study might be potential resources for diagnosis and therapies of MPOX patients. However, the findings require experimental validation in wet lab for further confirmation.

Although there are some vaccines against MPOX, most people worldwide are still not vaccinated due to their unawareness or unavailability. However, so far, there is no approved drug against MPOX yet. Therefore, effective drugs against MPOX are also essential. This study attempted to disclose pathogenic processes and therapeutic strategies of MPOX based on MPOX-associated host key-genes (hKGs). At first, three transcriptomic profile datasets were analyzed, identifying 166 common host differentially expressed genes (hDEGs) between MPOX patients and control groups, comprising 75 upregulated and 91 downregulated hDEGs. Subsequently, six top-ranked host key genes (hKGs): ALB, HSP90AA1, CDH1, PTPRC, IGF1, and ABL1, were identified as potential MPOX-causing genes through protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis. Functional enrichment analysis of these hKGs revealed critical pathogenic processes of MPOX infection, including biological processes, molecular functions, cellular components, and KEGG pathways. Regulatory network analysis involving transcription factors and miRNAs provided further insights into disease mechanisms. Based on molecular docking analysis, five top-ranked drug molecules Tecovirimat, Beclabuvir, Maraviroc, Raltegravir, and Brincidofovir were identified as potential repurposable therapeutics against MPOX. ADME/T and drug-likeness evaluations confirmed favorable pharmacokinetic properties for these candidates. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the top three complexes (ALB-Tecovirimat, CDH1-Maraviroc, and PPARG-Beclabuvir) demonstrated strong binding stability, supported by RMSD, RMSF, and MM-GBSA results. Therefore, the results provided in this study might be potential resources for diagnosis and therapies of MPOX patients. However, the findings require experimental validation in wet lab for further confirmation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to uncover the pathogenic mechanisms of the monkeypox virus and identify potential drug repurposing strategies. By analyzing transcriptomic profiles, the researchers identified 166 differentially expressed host genes, including six key genes involved in MPOX pathogenesis. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations suggested Tecovirimat, Beclabuvir, Maraviroc, Raltegravir, and Brincidofovir as promising therapeutic candidates. The findings highlight potential diagnostic and therapeutic resources for MPOX patients but emphasize the need for wet lab validation to confirm their efficacy. The study contributes to understanding the molecular basis of MPOX and offers new avenues for drug development, though its results are based on computational models and require further experimental testing.

papers.abstract_zh: 2022 年非洲发生的猴痘(猴痘)病毒感染 暴发 最初被认为是一种被忽视的热带病(NTD)。现在它被认为是一个全球性的健康问题。最近的全球蔓延强调了需要加大力度打击 猴痘。尽管存在一些针对 猴痘 的 疫苗,但全世界大多数人由于不了解或无法获得疫苗,仍然没有接种疫苗。然而,到目前为止,还没有针对猴痘的批准药物。因此,针对猴痘的有效药物也是必不可少的。本研究试图基于猴痘相关的宿主关键基因(hKGs)来揭示猴痘的致病过程和治疗策略。首先,分析了三个转录组图谱数据集,鉴定了 宿主 患者和对照组之间 166 个常见的 宿主 差异表达基因 (hDEG),其中包括 75 个上调 hDEG 和 91 个下调 hDEG。随后,通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用(PPI)网络分析,六个排名最高的 宿主 关键基因(hKG):ALB、HSP90AA1、CDH1、PTPRC、IGF1 和 ABL1 被鉴定为潜在的 宿主 致病基因。这些 hKG 的功能富集分析揭示了 猴痘 感染的关键致病过程,包括生物过程、分子功能、细胞成分和 KEGG 途径。涉及转录因子和 miRNA 的调控网络分析提供了对疾病机制的进一步见解。基于分子对接分析,五个排名靠前的药物分子 特考韦瑞、Beclabuvir、Maraviroc、Raltegravir 和 Brincidofovir 被确定为针对 猴痘 的潜在可重复利用疗法。ADME/T 和药物相似性评估证实了这些候选药物具有良好的药代动力学特性。此外,前三种复合物(ALB-特考韦瑞、CDH1-Maraviroc 和 PPARG-Beclabuvir)的 100 ns 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟显示出强大的结合稳定性,并得到 RMSD、RMSF 和 MM-GBSA 结果的支持。因此,本研究提供的结果可能是 诊断 和 猴痘 患者治疗的潜在资源。然而,该研究结果需要在湿实验室中进行实验验证才能进一步证实。

papers.title: Molecular Epidemiology to Decipher the Transmission Networks of Mpox in an Outbreak Scenario: Applications in Thailand During the 2023 Global Health Emergency.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The 2022 MPXV global health emergency highlighted the necessity for rapid diagnostic measures in response to mpox clade IIb outbreaks. This study investigates the mpox lineages identified in Thailand during this period and explores the transmission dynamics of dominant lineages. METHODS: Using targeted next-generation sequencing from 162 individuals infected with mpox, we created a transmission network map by linking high-similarity sequences through molecular-temporal distance matrices. RESULTS: Our findings reveal that the study population aligns with global trends of transmission almost exclusively within the community of men who have sex with men, with a majority of cases resulting from lineage C viruses as well as 8 additional sublineages. Within the observed substitutions, a majority of mutations were either G→A (n = 289, 49.74%) or C→T (n = 221, 38.04%), indicating APOBEC-3-driven deaminase activity. We also present a global transmission network for lineage C mpox genomes, illustrating domestic and international spread. CONCLUSIONS: This research underscores the significance of whole genome sequencing in diagnostics during outbreaks and the importance of sharing genomic data to enhance our understanding of disease transmission on a global scale.

papers.title: The aminoadamantane derivative 3F2 modulates monocyte and NK cell activation and restores immune mediators altered by Monkeypox virus stimuli
papers.abstract: Abstract The monkeypox virus (MPV) is known to employ multiple immune evasion strategies that compromise antiviral defenses and disrupt immune homeostasis. Here, we characterized the immune responses induced by stimulation with inactivated MPV and evaluated the ability of aminoadamantane (AMA) and its derivative, 3F2, to restore immune function. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells that were stimulated with MPV exhibited altered activation in a subset of monocytes, along with suppressed activation of natural killer (NK) and natural killer T (NKT) cells. MPV stimulation also led to significant changes in the levels of immunosoluble mediators, including reductions in chemokines and cytokines that are crucial for antiviral defense and immune regulation. Treatment with 3F2 proved to be more effective than AMA, resulting in significantly higher levels of CCL2, CXCL8, IFN-γ, IL-12(p40), IL-15, IL-5, and essential growth factors such as VEGF and NGF-β. Furthermore, 3F2 treatment partially reverses monocyte activation and re-establishes NK and NKT cell function. The current results indicate that 3F2 can control inflammation while preserving antiviral responsiveness. These findings demonstrate that inactivated MPV stimuli profoundly modulates innate immune activation and identify 3F2 as a promising immunomodulatory candidate capable of partially restoring immune responses altered by viral particle stimulation.
authors: Thaís de Fátima da Silva Moraes

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the immune responses induced by MPV stimulation and evaluate the ability of 3F2 to restore immune function. The monkeypox virus (MPV) is known to employ multiple immune evasion strategies that compromise antiviral defenses and disrupt immune homeostasis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated immune responses in peripheral blood mononuclear cells stimulated with inactivated MPV. The research was conducted in a laboratory setting using cells from human donors.
analysis.methods: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were stimulated with inactivated MPV and then exposed to aminoadamantane (AMA) and its derivative, 3F2. The activation status of monocytes, NK, and NKT cells was assessed, along with the levels of immunosoluble mediators such as chemokines and cytokines.
analysis.main_results: MPV stimulation led to significant changes in immunosoluble mediator levels, including reductions in chemokines and cytokines crucial for antiviral defense and immune regulation. Treatment with 3F2 resulted in significantly higher levels of CCL2, CXCL8, IFN-γ, IL-12(p40), IL-15, IL-5, and essential growth factors such as VEGF and NGF-β.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that 3F2 treatment proved to be more effective than AMA in restoring immune function. These findings demonstrate that inactivated MPV stimuli profoundly modulates innate immune activation and identify 3F2 as a promising immunomodulatory candidate capable of partially restoring immune responses altered by viral particle stimulation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that 3F2 could be a potential therapeutic agent for modulating immune responses in mpox disease. They also highlight the importance of understanding immune modulation in the context of MPV infection for developing targeted interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its use of in vitro models and does not account for in vivo effects. The evidence is strong as it directly compares the effects of 3F2 and AMA on immune mediators and activation states, with clear numerical results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immune responses induced by inactivated monkeypox virus (MPV) and evaluates the effectiveness of aminoadamantane (AMA) and its derivative, 3F2, in restoring immune function. The research demonstrates that MPV stimulation alters monocyte and NK cell activation, as well as immunosoluble mediator levels, which are crucial for antiviral defense. Treatment with 3F2 significantly increases levels of key mediators such as CCL2, CXCL8, IFN-γ, and growth factors like VEGF and NGF-β, indicating its potential as an immunomodulatory candidate. The findings suggest that 3F2 could be a promising therapeutic option for modulating immune responses in mpox disease. However, the study is limited to in vitro models, which may not fully reflect in vivo conditions. The evidence is strong due to direct comparisons and clear numerical results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在表征 MPV 刺激诱导的 免疫应答 并评估 3F2 恢复免疫功能的能力。众所周知,猴痘病毒 (MPV) 采用多种免疫逃避策略,损害 抗病毒药物 防御并破坏免疫稳态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了用灭活 MPV 刺激的外周血单核细胞中的 免疫应答。该研究是在实验室环境中使用人类捐赠者的细胞进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 用灭活的 MPV 刺激外周血单核细胞,然后暴露于氨基金刚烷 (AMA) 及其衍生物 3F2。评估了单核细胞、NK 和 NKT 细胞的激活状态,以及趋化因子和细胞因子等免疫可溶性介质的水平。
elements_zh.main_results: MPV 刺激导致免疫可溶性介质水平发生显着变化,包括对 抗病毒药物 防御和免疫调节至关重要的趋化因子和细胞因子的减少。治疗 与 3F2 联合使用可显着提高 CCL2、CXCL8、IFN-γ、IL-12(p40)、IL-15、IL-5 和必需生长因子(如 VEGF 和 NGF-β)的水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,事实证明,3F2 治疗 在恢复免疫功能方面比 AMA 更有效。这些发现表明,灭活的 MPV 刺激可深刻调节先天免疫激活,并将 3F2 确定为一种有前途的免疫调节候选物,能够部分恢复病毒颗粒刺激改变的 免疫应答。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,3F2 可能是调节 猴痘 疾病中 免疫应答 的潜在治疗剂。他们还强调了了解 MPV 感染背景下的免疫调节对于制定有针对性的干预措施的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到体外模型使用的限制,并且没有考虑体内效应。证据是强有力的,因为它直接比较了 3F2 和 AMA 对免疫介质和激活状态的影响,并具有清晰的数值结果。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 已知猴痘病毒 (MPV) 采用多种免疫逃避策略,损害 抗病毒药物 防御并破坏免疫稳态。在这里,我们对灭活 MPV 刺激诱导的 免疫应答 进行了表征,并评估了氨基金刚烷 (AMA) 及其衍生物 3F2 恢复免疫功能的能力。经 MPV 刺激的外周血单核细胞的一部分单核细胞的激活发生改变,同时自然杀伤 (NK) 和自然杀伤 T (NKT) 细胞的激活受到抑制。MPV 刺激还导致免疫可溶性介质水平发生显着变化,包括对 抗病毒药物 防御和免疫调节至关重要的趋化因子和细胞因子的减少。事实证明,治疗 联合 3F2 比 AMA 更有效,可显着提高 CCL2、CXCL8、IFN-γ、IL-12(p40)、IL-15、IL-5 以及必需生长因子(如 VEGF 和 NGF-β)的水平。此外,3F2 治疗 部分逆转单核细胞活化并重建 NK 和 NKT 细胞功能。目前的结果表明,3F2 可以控制炎症,同时保留 抗病毒药物 反应性。这些发现表明,灭活的 MPV 刺激可深刻调节先天免疫激活,并将 3F2 确定为一种有前途的免疫调节候选物,能够部分恢复病毒颗粒刺激改变的 免疫应答。

papers.title: Conservation guided reverse vaccinology for the design of a broadly immunogenic multi-epitope vaccine against monkeypox virus
papers.abstract: Mpox, caused by the Monkeypox virus (MPXV), has emerged as a global public health concern following outbreaks beyond its traditional endemic regions. Although existing smallpox-derived vaccines provide partial protection, their limitations and declining population immunity highlight the need for safer and more targeted vaccine strategies. This study aimed to identify conserved antigenic targets and design a multi-epitope vaccine candidate against MPXV using a conservation-guided immunoinformatics approach. A dataset of 27 complete MPXV genomes (2001–2025) from diverse geographic regions was analyzed to identify highly conserved viral genes. Conserved surface-exposed proteins were prioritized for epitope prediction, including cytotoxic T-lymphocyte, helper T-lymphocyte, and B-cell epitopes. High-confidence epitopes were selected based on binding affinity, antigenicity, immunogenicity, toxicity, allergenicity, and absence of human sequence homology. Promiscuous epitopes with broad human leukocyte antigen (HLA) binding were curated to maximize population coverage. Three multi-epitope vaccine constructs were designed using appropriate linkers and adjuvants. Structural modeling, molecular docking with innate immune receptors, immune response simulation, and codon optimization were performed to evaluate the constructs. All constructs were predicted to be stable, antigenic, and non-allergenic. Molecular docking indicated strong interactions of vaccine construct 2 (VC2) with TLR2 and the TLR4–MD-2 complex, achieving the highest binding affinities (ΔG = − 19.6 and − 27.8 kcal/mol, respectively). Immune simulations predicted robust humoral and cellular responses, including strong antibody production and interferon-γ induction for VC2. Population coverage analysis estimated 99.27% global coverage, and codon optimization suggested efficient expression in Escherichia coli . Overall, VC2 emerges as a promising multi-epitope vaccine candidate with strong predicted immunogenic and structural properties. While these computational findings lay a solid foundation, VC2 require further experimental validation and preclinical development as a targeted vaccine strategy against MPXV.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 是由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的,继 暴发 超越其传统流行地区之后,已成为全球公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对来自不同地理区域的 27 个完整 MPXV 基因组 (2001-2025) 的数据集进行了分析,以识别高度保守的病毒基因。
elements_zh.methods: 保守的表面暴露蛋白优先用于表位预测,包括细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞、辅助 T 淋巴细胞和 B 细胞表位。根据结合亲和力、抗原性、免疫原性、毒性、过敏原性和人类序列同源性的缺乏来选择高置信度表位。精心设计了具有广泛人类白细胞抗原 (HLA) 结合的混杂表位,以最大限度地扩大人群覆盖范围。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用适当的接头和佐剂设计了三个多表位 疫苗 构建体。进行结构建模、与先天免疫受体的分子对接、免疫应答 模拟和密码子优化来评估构建体。预计所有构建体都是稳定的、抗原性的和非过敏性的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 疫苗 构建体 2 (VC2) 预计与 TLR2 和 TLR4-MD-2 复合物具有最强的相互作用,实现最高的结合亲和力(分别为 ΔG = -19.6 和 -27.8 kcal/mol)。免疫模拟预测了强烈的体液和细胞反应,包括强抗体产生和 VC2 的干扰素-γ 诱导。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发具有针对 MPXV 的广泛免疫原性潜力的多表位 疫苗 候选药物奠定了基础,这可以增强全球针对 猴痘 暴发 的准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 虽然这些计算结果奠定了坚实的基础,但 VC2 需要进一步的实验验证和临床前开发,作为针对 MPXV 的有针对性的 疫苗 策略。

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘 是由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的,继 暴发 超越其传统流行地区之后,已成为全球公共卫生问题。尽管现有的天花衍生 疫苗 提供了部分保护,但其局限性和人群免疫力下降突出表明需要更安全、更有针对性的 疫苗 策略。本研究旨在识别保守的抗原靶标,并使用保守引导的免疫信息学方法设计针对 MPXV 的多表位 疫苗 候选药物。对来自不同地理区域的 27 个完整 MPXV 基因组 (2001-2025) 的数据集进行了分析,以识别高度保守的病毒基因。保守的表面暴露蛋白优先用于表位预测,包括细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞、辅助 T 淋巴细胞和 B 细胞表位。根据结合亲和力、抗原性、免疫原性、毒性、过敏原性和人类序列同源性的缺乏来选择高置信度表位。精心设计了具有广泛人类白细胞抗原 (HLA) 结合的混杂表位,以最大限度地扩大人群覆盖范围。使用适当的接头和佐剂设计了三个多表位 疫苗 构建体。进行结构建模、与先天免疫受体的分子对接、免疫应答 模拟和密码子优化来评估构建体。预计所有构建体都是稳定的、抗原性的和非过敏性的。分子对接表明 疫苗 构建体 2 (VC2) 与 TLR2 和 TLR4-MD-2 复合物有很强的相互作用,实现了最高的结合亲和力(分别为 ΔG = − 19.6 和 − 27.8 kcal/mol)。免疫模拟预测了强烈的体液和细胞反应,包括强抗体产生和 VC2 的干扰素-γ 诱导。群体覆盖度分析估计全球覆盖度为 99.27%,密码子优化表明在大肠杆菌中有效表达。总体而言,VC2 成为一种有前途的多表位 疫苗 候选药物,具有强大的预测免疫原性和结构特性。虽然这些计算结果奠定了坚实的基础,但 VC2 需要进一步的实验验证和临床前开发,作为针对 MPXV 的有针对性的 疫苗 策略。

papers.title: Airborne transmission risk of monkeypox virus: the importance of infection-competent virus.
papers.abstract: Zhaoliang Chen and colleagues1 propose that quantitative PCR (qPCR) cycle threshold (Ct) values exceeding 35 in massive-volume air sampling should not be equated with airborne transmissibility for monkeypox virus. Although this opinion might have practical utility, it does not address the fundamental biological basis for estimating transmissibility: the material being detected must be infectious for there to be transmission potential. We argue that a Ct value alone should not be considered as evidence of transmission potential, as qPCR cannot distinguish between nucleic acid from infection-competent virions and nucleic acid from degraded virions that pose no infection potential and therefore no transmission potential.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a letter published in The Lancet. Microbe, focusing on monkeypox virus and its airborne transmission risk, with no specific population or setting described beyond the general context of the virus.
analysis.methods: The authors propose that quantitative PCR (qPCR) cycle threshold (Ct) values exceeding 35 in massive-volume air sampling should not be equated with airborne transmissibility for monkeypox virus, highlighting the limitations of qPCR in distinguishing between infectious and non-infectious viral material.
analysis.main_results: The study does not report any direct results or numerical findings but raises a critical point about the interpretation of qPCR Ct values in assessing airborne transmission potential.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that qPCR alone cannot determine transmission potential, as it cannot differentiate between infection-competent virions and degraded virions, and they emphasize the need for a more accurate biological basis for estimating transmissibility.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that current methods for assessing airborne transmission risk of monkeypox virus may be insufficient, which has implications for public health surveillance and risk assessment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a theoretical discussion and does not present empirical data, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment based on the lack of direct experimental evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the limitations of using qPCR cycle threshold (Ct) values to assess airborne transmission risk of monkeypox virus. They emphasize the need for a more accurate biological basis for estimating transmissibility, which has implications for public health surveillance and risk assessment. The study is a letter published in The Lancet. Microbe, and while it raises important considerations, it lacks direct experimental evidence, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: Public Knowledge, Attitudes, and Preventive Practices Regarding Mpox in Bangladesh: Insights From a Community-Based Cross-Sectional Survey.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Mpox has recently re-emerged as a significant global health concern, highlighting the importance of public awareness and preventive measures. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding Mpox and its epidemiology, prevention, and control measures among the general population of Bangladesh. METHODS: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from June 2024 to September 2024 among 1002 participants across 16 districts, using a multi-stage random sampling approach following STROBE guidelines. Data were collected through a structured questionnaire covering sociodemographics, knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Both univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were used to determine associations between sociodemographic factors and KAP outcomes. RESULTS: Out of 1002 respondents, only 37.2% demonstrated good knowledge of Mpox, while 74.0% had positive attitudes, and 80.0% reported satisfactory preventive practices. Awareness of Mpox as a viral disease was limited (37.3%), and only 22.5% knew about the protective role of smallpox vaccination. Higher education was strongly associated with good knowledge (AOR = 11.8; 95% CI: 5.61-25.8), positive attitudes (AOR = 5.68; 95% CI: 2.63-12.5), and satisfactory practices (AOR = 6.49; 95% CI: 2.62-16.8). Non-border residents were more likely to report positive attitudes (AOR = 3.07; p < 0.001) and satisfactory practices (AOR = 3.84; p < 0.001). Urban (AOR = 2.28; p = 0.003) and semi-urban (AOR = 2.19; p = 0.014) participants showed more positive attitudes. Attitudes and practices showed the strongest correlation (ρ = 0.793, p < 0.001), indicating a strong association between attitudes and preventive practices. CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that gaps in awareness and training are associated with suboptimal practices, highlighting potential areas for targeted educational interventions. Strengthening community-level awareness and preparedness may support public health readiness for potential Mpox outbreaks in Bangladesh.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目标:猴痘 最近重新成为一个重大的全球健康问题,凸显了公众意识和预防措施的重要性。本研究旨在评估孟加拉国普通民众对 猴痘 及其 流行病学、预防和控制措施的知识、态度和实践 (KAP)。方法:2024 年 6 月至 2024 年 9 月,采用遵循 STROBE 指南的多阶段随机抽样方法,对 16 个地区的 1002 名参与者进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查。通过结构化调查问卷收集数据,涵盖社会人口统计、知识、态度和实践。使用单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析来确定社会人口因素与 KAP 结果之间的关联。结果:在 1002 名受访者中,只有 37.2% 的人表现出对 猴痘 的良好了解,而 74.0% 的人持积极态度,80.0% 的人表示令人满意的预防措施。对 猴痘 作为病毒性疾病的认识有限(37.3%),只有 22.5% 的人知道天花 疫苗接种 的保护作用。高等教育与良好知识(AOR = 11.8;95% CI:5.61-25.8)、积极态度(AOR = 5.68;95% CI:2.63-12.5)和令人满意的实践(AOR = 6.49;95% CI:2.62-16.8)密切相关。非边境居民更有可能报告积极态度(AOR = 3.07;p < 0.001)和令人满意的做法(AOR = 3.84;p < 0.001)。城市(AOR = 2.28;p = 0.003)和半城市(AOR = 2.19;p = 0.014)参与者表现出更积极的态度。态度和实践表现出最强的相关性(ρ = 0.793,p < 0.001),表明态度和预防实践之间存在很强的关联。结论:研究结果表明,意识和培训方面的差距与次优实践有关,突出了有针对性的教育干预的潜在领域。加强社区层面的认识和准备可能有助于孟加拉国为潜在的 猴痘 暴发 做好公共卫生准备。

papers.title: Geospatial analysis and predictive modelling of mpox transmission hotspots: a case study of Ogun State, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Mpox is a recurring public health threat in Nigeria and was re-declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024. Nigeria's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system operates at the Local Government Area (LGA) level, yet published mpox risk models resolve risk only at state level, forcing uniform deployment across heterogeneous LGAs. This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates. Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low. The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘 是尼日利亚反复出现的公共卫生威胁,并于 2024 年 8 月被重新宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。尼日利亚的综合疾病 猴痘 和响应系统在地方政府地区 (LGA) 层面运行,但发布的 猴痘 风险模型仅在州层面解决风险,迫使异构地方政府地区进行统一部署。本研究开发并评估了奥贡州 20 个 LGA 的 LGA 分辨率地理空间风险层,并将其作为概念验证集成到实时 监测 平台中。40 例实验室确诊病例(NCDC,2022 年)和 151 例疑似病例(奥贡州卫生部,2022 年至 2024 年)的州级记录,总共 191 例,在空间上分解为 189 个伪存在点,并使用最大熵、随机森林和极端梯度提升的集合建模,超过 100 个引导重复。在随机保留下(AUC 0.77;博伊斯指数 0.99),歧视性良好,但在空间阻塞交叉验证(AUC 0.57)下,歧视性下降,表明该层适合于层之间的粗略分类,而不是层内排名。沿阿贝奥库塔南和伊杰布-雷莫轴线的中央走廊,有 7 个地方政府行政区被列为高风险,6 个为中风险,7 个为低风险。分层层导出为具有特定于层的操作包的 GeoJSON,并集成到 IDS-Master 平台中,作为从空间 流行病学 到常规公共卫生 流行病学 的概念验证途径。由于 189 个点是从总计数中分解出来的,而不是单独进行地理定位的,因此这些层应被解读为分诊的空间先验,而不是已确认的病例位置。

papers.title: AIRIME: a scalable adaptive RIME algorithm for feature optimization and data-driven monkeypox disease prediction
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of big data in recent applications has created a pressing need for scalable and efficient optimization algorithms capable of handling large-scale and high-dimensional problems. Addressing this challenge, an Adaptive Improved Rime-Ice Optimization algorithm (AIRIME) is proposed which is built on the physics-based RIME algorithm inspired by the formation of soft and hard rime on surfaces. While RIME offers a strong theoretical foundation, it is hindered by limited exploratory capability, slow convergence, and an imbalance between exploration and exploitation. AIRIME introduces four key enhancements, including Adaptive k-Average-Best Mutation (AKAB), Adaptive Searching Process (ASP), Enhanced Solution Quality (ESQ), and Gaussian-Based Optimal Solution Mutation (GBOM), to overcome these challenges and meet the requirements of big data applications. AIRIME was rigorously tested on 41 functions from the CEC2017 and CEC2022 test suites, outperforming various classical, recent and advanced algorithms. Statistical evaluations, including Friedman rank and Wilcoxon rank tests, validated its superior performance and robustness. Sensitivity analyses further demonstrated the adaptability and efficiency of the proposed strategies. Moreover, a binary version of AIRIME was applied to feature selection (FS) tasks across 14 datasets, achieving promising results compared to various established binary metaheuristics. Furthermore, its real-world applicability was demonstrated in a novel Monkeypox disease prediction framework, where AIRIME helped to achieve an exceptional classification accuracy of 95.52% while selecting significantly fewer features, underscoring its efficiency in classifying high-dimensional healthcare data. Thus, AIRIME represents a significant advancement in big data-driven optimization, combining scalability, adaptability, and robustness to address complex and high-dimensional challenges across various domains, including critical healthcare applications.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for scalable and efficient optimization algorithms to handle large-scale and high-dimensional problems, particularly in the context of big data applications. The background highlights the growing importance of such algorithms in managing complex data sets.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and testing of the AIRIME algorithm on 41 benchmark functions from the CEC2017 and CEC2022 test suites, as well as its application to 14 datasets for feature selection tasks. The algorithm was also evaluated for its real-world applicability in a monkeypox disease prediction framework.
analysis.methods: The AIRIME algorithm was enhanced with four key strategies: Adaptive k-Average-Best Mutation (AKAB), Adaptive Searching Process (ASP), Enhanced Solution Quality (ESQ), and Gaussian-Based Optimal Solution Mutation (GBOM). These were implemented to improve the algorithm's performance in handling high-dimensional data and to validate its effectiveness through statistical tests such as Friedman rank and Wilcoxon rank tests.
analysis.main_results: AIRIME outperformed various classical, recent, and advanced algorithms on the CEC2017 and CEC2022 test suites. Sensitivity analyses confirmed its adaptability and efficiency, and its binary version achieved promising results in feature selection tasks. Additionally, it demonstrated exceptional classification accuracy of 95.52% in a monkeypox disease prediction framework while selecting significantly fewer features.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these results as evidence of AIRIME's significant advancement in big data-driven optimization, particularly in its ability to address complex and high-dimensional challenges in healthcare applications. The novelty lies in its adaptability, scalability, and robustness for real-world use.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that AIRIME can be used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of disease prediction frameworks, particularly for monkeypox, by optimizing feature selection in high-dimensional healthcare data. This has implications for better surveillance and early detection systems.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to benchmark functions and datasets, which may not fully represent real-world complexities. However, the results are supported by rigorous statistical evaluations, indicating a moderate level of confidence in the algorithm's performance.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces the AIRIME algorithm, an Adaptive Improved Rime-Ice Optimization algorithm designed to address the challenges of handling large-scale and high-dimensional data in big data applications. The algorithm was tested on 41 benchmark functions from the CEC2017 and CEC2022 test suites, outperforming various classical, recent, and advanced algorithms. Additionally, its binary version was applied to 14 datasets for feature selection tasks, achieving promising results. The algorithm was also demonstrated in a monkeypox disease prediction framework, where it achieved an exceptional classification accuracy of 95.52% while selecting significantly fewer features. The authors interpret these results as a significant advancement in big data-driven optimization, particularly for healthcare applications. The study's findings suggest that AIRIME can improve disease prediction systems, especially for monkeypox, by optimizing feature selection in high-dimensional data. However, the study is limited to benchmark functions and datasets, which may not fully capture real-world complexities, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决对可扩展且高效的优化算法的需求,以处理大规模和高维问题,特别是在大数据应用的背景下。这一背景凸显了此类算法在管理复杂数据集方面日益重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及在 CEC2017 和 CEC2022 测试套件中的 41 个基准函数上开发和测试 AIRIME 算法,以及将其应用于 14 个数据集以执行特征选择任务。该算法还评估了其在猴痘疾病预测框架中的实际适用性。
elements_zh.methods: AIRIME 算法通过四个关键策略进行了增强:自适应 k 平均最佳 突变 (AKAB)、自适应搜索过程 (ASP)、增强解质量 (ESQ) 和基于高斯的最优解 突变 (GBOM)。实施这些措施是为了提高算法处理高维数据的性能,并通过弗里德曼等级和威尔科克森等级测试等统计测试来验证其有效性。
elements_zh.main_results: AIRIME 在 CEC2017 和 CEC2022 测试套件上的表现优于各种经典、最新和高级算法。敏感性分析证实了其适应性和效率,其二进制版本在特征选择任务中取得了可喜的结果。此外,它在猴痘疾病预测框架中表现出 95.52% 的出色分类准确率,同时选择的特征明显更少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为 AIRIME 在大数据驱动优化方面取得重大进步的证据,特别是其解决医疗保健应用中复杂和高维挑战的能力。新颖之处在于它的适应性、可扩展性和现实世界使用的稳健性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,AIRIME 可通过优化高维医疗数据中的特征选择来提高疾病预测框架的准确性和效率,特别是猴痘。这对更好的 监测 和早期检测系统具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于基准函数和数据集,可能无法完全代表现实世界的复杂性。然而,这些结果得到了严格的统计评估的支持,表明对该算法的性能有一定的信心。

papers.abstract_zh: 最近应用中大数据的快速增长迫切需要能够处理大规模和高维问题的可扩展且高效的优化算法。为了解决这一挑战,提出了一种自适应改进雾凇-冰优化算法(AIRIME),该算法建立在基于物理的 RIME 算法的基础上,该算法受到表面软雾和硬雾凇形成的启发。虽然 RIME 提供了坚实的理论基础,但它受到有限的探索能力、缓慢的收敛以及探索与开发之间的不平衡的阻碍。AIRIME引入了四项关键增强功能,包括自适应k平均最佳突变(AKAB)、自适应搜索过程(ASP)、增强解质量(ESQ)和基于高斯的最优解突变(GBOM),以克服这些挑战并满足大数据应用的要求。AIRIME 在 CEC2017 和 CEC2022 测试套件的 41 项功能上进行了严格测试,性能优于各种经典、最新和高级算法。统计评估,包括 Friedman 等级和 Wilcoxon 等级检验,验证了其卓越的性能和稳健性。敏感性分析进一步证明了所提出策略的适应性和效率。此外,AIRIME 的二进制版本应用于 14 个数据集的特征选择 (FS) 任务,与各种已建立的二进制元启发法相比,取得了有希望的结果。此外,其在现实世界中的适用性在新型猴痘疾病预测框架中得到了证明,其中 AIRIME 帮助实现了 95.52% 的出色分类准确率,同时选择的特征明显减少,强调了其对高维医疗数据进行分类的效率。因此,AIRIME 代表了大数据驱动优化方面的重大进步,它将可扩展性、适应性和鲁棒性结合起来,以解决包括关键医疗保健应用在内的各个领域的复杂和高维挑战。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决对可扩展且高效的优化算法的需求,以处理大规模和高维问题,特别是在大数据应用的背景下。这一背景凸显了此类算法在管理复杂数据集方面日益重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及在 CEC2017 和 CEC2022 测试套件中的 41 个基准函数上开发和测试 AIRIME 算法,以及将其应用于 14 个数据集以执行特征选择任务。该算法还评估了其在猴痘疾病预测框架中的实际适用性。
analysis_zh.methods: AIRIME 算法通过四个关键策略进行了增强:自适应 k 平均最佳 突变 (AKAB)、自适应搜索过程 (ASP)、增强解质量 (ESQ) 和基于高斯的最优解 突变 (GBOM)。实施这些措施是为了提高算法处理高维数据的性能,并通过弗里德曼等级和威尔科克森等级测试等统计测试来验证其有效性。
analysis_zh.main_results: AIRIME 在 CEC2017 和 CEC2022 测试套件上的表现优于各种经典、最新和高级算法。敏感性分析证实了其适应性和效率,其二进制版本在特征选择任务中取得了可喜的结果。此外,它在猴痘疾病预测框架中表现出 95.52% 的出色分类准确率,同时选择的特征明显更少。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为 AIRIME 在大数据驱动优化方面取得重大进步的证据,特别是其解决医疗保健应用中复杂和高维挑战的能力。新颖之处在于它的适应性、可扩展性和现实世界使用的稳健性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,AIRIME 可通过优化高维医疗数据中的特征选择来提高疾病预测框架的准确性和效率,特别是猴痘。这对更好的 监测 和早期检测系统具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于基准函数和数据集,可能无法完全代表现实世界的复杂性。然而,这些结果得到了严格的统计评估的支持,表明对该算法的性能有一定的信心。

papers.title: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025
papers.abstract: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

papers.full_text: AbstractMpox (formerly known as monkeypox) has re-emerged globally as a significant public health concern, with dermatology services occupying a key role in early recognition due to its predominant mucocutaneous manifestations. We present a series of four confirmed mpox cases diagnosed in April 2025 at a tertiary dermatology center in Jalisco, Mexico. All cases occurred in men who have sex with men, three of whom were living with HIV. Clinical presentations were heterogeneous, ranging from disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions with systemic symptoms to strictly localized, painful perianal lesions without prodrome. One case was initially misdiagnosed as herpes, underscoring the diagnostic complexity and potential overlap with other sexually transmitted dermatoses. Epidemiologic risk factors included recent unprotected sexual encounters and, in one case, recent travel. Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR and supported by compatible histopathology when performed. This cluster within a short timeframe reflects ongoing community transmission and highlights the importance of maintaining high clinical suspicion, integrating empathetic and stigma-free sexual history-taking, and leveraging epidemiologic clues for early detection. Increasing diagnostic awareness in dermatology practice is essential to mitigate under-recognition, guide timely management, and support containment strategies.Keywords: hiv aids, monkeypox, monkeypox diagnosis, monkeypox treatment, monkeypox virus DiscussionThis case series illustrates the evolving clinical spectrum of mpox and reinforces dermatology's critical role in early recognition and diagnosis. Since the 2022 global outbreak, mpox has demonstrated sustained transmission outside historically endemic regions, particularly among MSM [1,2]. Similar to international and national reports, the four cases in our series occurred exclusively in MSM, and three patients were living with HIV, a population shown to have higher incidence and occasionally more severe or atypical presentations [2,3,6]. Importantly, one patient in our series was immunocompetent, underscoring that mpox is not restricted to immunocompromised hosts. Compatible mucocutaneous manifestations may occur irrespective of HIV status, and epidemiologic exposure should therefore remain a central component of clinical suspicion [6].Classically, mpox presents with a systemic prodrome followed by disseminated vesiculopustular lesions [2]. However, consistent with recent literature, our findings highlight significant clinical heterogeneity: two patients presented with isolated, painful perianal lesions, whereas one experienced initial mucosal involvement with odynophagia preceding the development of cutaneous findings. These atypical presentations align with recent evidence describing localized anogenital disease and mucosal-first involvement in sexually acquired mpox, which can mimic other sexually transmitted infections such as herpes simplex virus infection or syphilis [2,3,6]. One of our cases was initially misdiagnosed as herpes, underscoring how mpox can masquerade as other dermatoses, potentially delaying appropriate management and containment measures.Herpes simplex infection, syphilis, and other sexually transmitted infections were therefore considered clinically relevant differential diagnoses in this series. Importantly, the diagnosis of mpox was not established solely through exclusion of these entities but was confirmed by PCR, with supportive histopathologic findings when performed. A uniform laboratory screening panel for every alternative sexually transmitted infection was not consistently documented in the available clinical records. Consequently, these infections are presented as clinically relevant differential diagnoses rather than as uniformly laboratory-excluded conditions.Epidemiologic information remains essential for diagnosis. All patients reported recent sexual exposure, consistent with reports identifying close and sexual contact networks as important drivers of transmission [2-4]. Prompt PCR confirmation and histopathologic assessment when performed supported the diagnostic process. The identification of four confirmed cases within a single month at our center suggests ongoing regional transmission and potential under-recognition, consistent with continued surveillance reports in Mexico and internationally [4,5].Vaccination represents an additional component of mpox prevention. Vaccines based on vaccinia virus, including Modified Vaccinia Ankara-Bavarian Nordic (MVA-BN) and LC16m8, are recommended by the World Health Organization for individuals at increased risk of exposure according to epidemiologic circumstances, individual risk, vaccine availability, and national public health policies [7]. Vaccine availability remains heterogeneous among countries. In the United States, JYNNEOS, an MVA-BN vaccine, is recommended for individuals at increased risk of mpox and may also be used for post-exposure prophylaxis when clinically indicated [8]. Although vaccination was not the focus of the present case series, awareness of available preventive strategies complements timely clinical recognition and public health containment.Our findings reinforce the importance of maintaining a high index of suspicion for mpox in patients presenting with vesiculopustular, mucosal, genital, or anogenital lesions, particularly when epidemiologic risk factors are present. Importantly, such suspicion should not depend exclusively on HIV status or the presence of systemic symptoms. A non-judgmental, detailed sexual history is indispensable for reducing missed diagnoses and stigma-related barriers to care [2,3]. Ongoing physician education and clear clinical protocols are necessary to ensure timely identification and mitigate further spread [2,4,6].Several limitations should be acknowledged. This report represents a small retrospective case series from a single tertiary referral center. CD4 counts, HIV viral loads, specific antiretroviral regimens, and complete tecovirimat dosing and duration data were not consistently available in the clinical records. Likewise, laboratory testing for alternative sexually transmitted infections was not uniformly documented. Consequently, the present series was not designed to assess associations between immunologic status, specific antiretroviral or antiviral therapies, and disease severity. Nevertheless, these limitations do not affect the confirmed diagnosis of mpox in the reported cases or the primary descriptive objective of illustrating its heterogeneous dermatologic presentations. ConclusionsThis case series highlights the diverse clinical spectrum of mpox encountered in dermatologic practice, ranging from classic disseminated vesiculopustular disease to localized anogenital presentations with limited or absent systemic manifestations. The predominance of MSM and individuals living with HIV in this series is consistent with reported epidemiologic patterns; however, the occurrence of disease in an immunocompetent patient emphasizes that clinical suspicion should not depend exclusively on immune status.Early diagnosis relies on recognizing atypical forms, maintaining a broad differential diagnosis, and integrating thorough, stigma-free sexual and travel history-taking into routine assessment. Strengthening clinician awareness, ensuring timely access to diagnostic testing, and promoting preventive strategies, including vaccination when indicated and available, are important for avoiding misdiagnosis, enabling prompt management, and supporting public health containment efforts. Continued surveillance and reporting remain essential to better characterize evolving transmission patterns and the clinical behavior of mpox in diverse populations. IntroductionMpox, formerly known as monkeypox, is an emerging zoonotic infection caused by an orthopoxvirus, which has transitioned from a sporadic, endemic disease in Central and West Africa to a global public health concern since 2022 [1,2]. Although transmission historically involved animal-human contact, recent outbreaks have demonstrated sustained human-to-human transmission, particularly through close physical and sexual contact, with a disproportionately high incidence among men who have sex with men (MSM) [2-4].The epidemiologic relevance of mpox has persisted beyond the initial 2022 multinational outbreak. According to World Health Organization surveillance, 63,692 laboratory-confirmed cases and 256 deaths were reported across 105 countries between January 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026 [5]. These data demonstrate continued global transmission and reinforce the importance of sustained clinical awareness even outside the initial outbreak period.Clinically, mpox is characterized by mucocutaneous lesions that classically progress from macules to vesicles and pustules; however, presentations are heterogeneous, and atypical forms confined to genital or perianal regions have been increasingly recognized [2,6]. Systemic manifestations such as fever, lymphadenopathy, and malaise may precede cutaneous findings but can be absent in a subset of patients, particularly those with localized disease [3]. Such variability may lead to diagnostic challenges and misclassification as other sexually associated dermatoses, including herpes simplex virus infection or syphilis, emphasizing the crucial role of dermatologists in timely recognition [2,3,6].In Mexico, rising mpox cases have been documented intermittently since the 2022 global outbreak, with surveillance demonstrating ongoing transmission [4]. Early identification remains essential to limit spread and initiate adequate supportive care. Given the evolving epidemiologic patterns and potential under-recognition, dermatology services must maintain a high index of suspicion and integrate thorough, stigma-free sexual and travel history-taking into routine practice.This report describes four confirmed mpox cases diagnosed over a one-month period in a tertiary referral center in Jalisco, Mexico, highlighting clinical heterogeneity and reinforcing the importance of epidemiologic context in dermatologic assessment and early diagnosis. Case presentationCase 1A 41-year-old man with newly diagnosed HIV presented with a one-month history of a disseminated polymorphous eruption including pustules, umbilicated vesicles, and crusted lesions on the face, trunk, extremities, palms, soles, and oral mucosa. Systemic symptoms included pruritus, fever, and cervical/inguinal lymphadenopathy. He reported multiple male sexual partners and recent unprotected intercourse. The eruption was initially misdiagnosed as herpes simplex infection, delaying appropriate treatment. Skin biopsy was compatible with mpox (Figure 1).Figure 1(A) Dermatoscopy showing characteristic form for this lesion, (B) Distribution in the back (C) Lesions in the armTreatmentHe received symptomatic therapy with antipyretics, oral analgesics, antihistamines, and daily cleansing of lesions. Given his HIV status and extensive mucocutaneous involvement, tecovirimat was initiated.ResponseWithin the first week, systemic symptoms improved and lesions began to crust. By day 18 of treatment, nearly all lesions had fully resolved.Follow-UpAt four weeks, no new lesions were observed and all cutaneous and mucosal findings had healed without scarring or superinfection. His antiretroviral therapy was optimized after diagnosis.Case 2A 40-year-old man living with HIV (treatment interruption three months prior) presented with localized painful umbilicated papules forming perianal plaques. Symptoms began one week prior, following prodromal fatigue and diarrhea. He reported more than 100 male sexual partners and recent high-risk anal contact. Biopsy showed findings consistent with mpox (Figure 2).Figure 2Perianal lesionsTreatmentBecause of immunosuppression and severe perianal pain, he received nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), topical anesthetics, and hygiene measures. Tecovirimat was started due to clinical severity and uncontrolled HIV.ResponseHe experienced significant reduction in pain and inflammation within the first week. Lesions crusted and resolved completely by days 14 to 16.Follow-UpAt a three-week evaluation, all lesions had healed without functional impairment. He resumed antiretroviral therapy and was referred for sexual health counseling.Case 3A 28-year-old man without known comorbidities presented with fever, headache, asthenia, and diaphoresis, followed by oral and pharyngeal lesions causing odynophagia. Days later, non-painful genital and hand lesions developed. He reported sexual contact with men ~15 days before onset and recent travel to Guanajuato. Skin biopsy confirmed mpox (Figure 3).Figure 3(A) Dorsal penile cutaneous lesion (B) Perioral lesions (C) Lesion on the nasal alaTreatmentHe was managed with oral analgesics, hydration, and topical antiseptics. Due to severe odynophagia, topical lidocaine and short-course corticosteroids were used for symptom control. Antiviral therapy was not indicated as disease remained mild and he was immunocompetent.ResponseSystemic symptoms resolved within five days. Mucosal and cutaneous lesions crusted and detached over 10 to 14 days.Follow-UpAt a four-week visit, no recurrence or complications were present. Only mild post-inflammatory erythema persisted.Case 4A 32-year-old man with HIV on antiretroviral therapy and a recent history of tuberculosis presented with localized painful umbilicated papules forming perianal plaques, without fever or prodromal symptoms. Symptoms began abruptly two days after unprotected sexual contact. PCR and biopsy were consistent with mpox (Figure 4).Figure 4(A and B) Perianal lesionsTreatmentHe received analgesics, daily cleansing, and topical lidocaine for pain. Because of his HIV status and history of opportunistic infection, tecovirimat was started early.ResponsePain improved markedly within 72 hours. Lesions showed rapid crusting and resolution during the following week, without bacterial superinfection.Follow-UpBy the three-week follow-up visit, lesions had completely resolved with no scarring. His HIV parameters remained stable under ongoing antiretroviral therapy. By day 18 of treatment, nearly all lesions had fully resolved.Follow-UpAt four weeks, no new lesions were observed and all cutaneous and mucosal findings had healed without scarring or superinfection. He resumed antiretroviral therapy and was referred for sexual health counseling.Case 3A 28-year-old man without known comorbidities presented with fever, headache, asthenia, and diaphoresis, followed by oral and pharyngeal lesions causing odynophagia. PCR and biopsy were consistent with mpox (Figure 4).Figure 4(A and B) Perianal lesionsTreatmentHe received analgesics, daily cleansing, and topical lidocaine for pain. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to highlight the evolving clinical spectrum of mpox and reinforce dermatology's role in early recognition and diagnosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a retrospective case series of four confirmed mpox cases diagnosed at a tertiary dermatology center in Jalisco, Mexico, between April 2025 and May 2025. All patients were men who have sex with men (MSM), with three living with HIV, reflecting the epidemiologic patterns observed in other regions.
analysis.methods: Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR and supported by compatible histopathology when performed. PCR and biopsy results were consistent with mpox, and the diagnostic process was aided by thorough sexual and travel history-taking.
analysis.main_results: All patients reported recent sexual exposure, with one patient having more than 100 male sexual partners and recent high-risk anal contact. The cases demonstrated clinical heterogeneity, including isolated perianal lesions and mucosal involvement with odynophagia preceding cutaneous findings. Biopsy showed findings consistent with mpox.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the clinical presentations of mpox in dermatologic practice are diverse, ranging from classic disseminated disease to localized anogenital forms. This highlights the need for broad differential diagnosis and the importance of epidemiologic context in early detection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of maintaining a high index of suspicion for mpox in patients with vesiculopustular, mucosal, genital, or anogenital lesions, particularly when epidemiologic risk factors are present. They also support the need for continued surveillance to better understand transmission patterns and clinical behavior.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a small number of cases from a single tertiary referral center, which may affect generalizability. However, the confirmed diagnoses and consistent clinical presentations provide moderate evidence for the observed patterns.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case series of four confirmed mpox cases diagnosed at a tertiary dermatology center in Jalisco, Mexico, in April 2025. The cases highlight the evolving clinical spectrum of mpox, with presentations ranging from classic disseminated disease to localized anogenital forms. All patients were men who have sex with men (MSM), and three were living with HIV, consistent with global epidemiologic trends. Diagnosis was confirmed by PCR and supported by histopathology. The study underscores the importance of maintaining a high index of suspicion for mpox in patients with vesiculopustular or mucosal lesions, particularly when risk factors such as recent sexual exposure are present. However, the small sample size and single-center design limit the generalizability of the findings, resulting in moderate confidence in the observed patterns.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在强调 猴痘 不断变化的临床谱,并强化皮肤科在早期识别和 诊断 中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对 2025 年 4 月至 2025 年 5 月期间在墨西哥哈利斯科州一家三级皮肤科中心诊断的四例 猴痘 确诊病例的回顾性病例系列。所有患者均为男男性行为者 (MSM),其中 3 例感染艾滋病毒,反映了在其他地区观察到的流行病学模式。
elements_zh.methods: 诊断 通过 PCR 得到证实,并在执行时得到兼容的组织病理学支持。PCR 和活检结果与 猴痘 一致,并且彻底的性行为史和旅行史记录有助于诊断过程。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有患者均报告近期有过性接触,其中一名患者有超过 100 名男性性伴侣且近期存在高风险肛门接触。这些病例表现出临床异质性,包括孤立的肛周病变和粘膜受累并伴有吞咽痛先于皮肤表现。活检显示结果与 猴痘 一致。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,猴痘 在皮肤病学实践中的临床表现多种多样,从经典的播散性疾病到局部肛门生殖器形式。这凸显了广泛区分 诊断 的必要性以及流行病学背景在早期检测中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了对水疱脓疱、粘膜、生殖器或肛门生殖器病变患者保持高度怀疑 猴痘 的重要性,特别是当存在流行病学危险因素时。他们还支持需要继续使用 监测 来更好地了解 传播 模式和临床行为。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于来自单个三级转诊中心的少量病例,这可能会影响普遍性。然而,确诊的诊断和一致的临床表现为观察到的模式提供了适度的证据。

papers.title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
papers.abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
papers.journal: Recent Advances in Computer Science and Communications

The authors argue this represents a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening and could accelerate public health responses. However, the abstract-only evidence lacks dataset size, external validation, and prospective clinical evaluation, constraining generalisability and evidence strength.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

papers.title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
papers.abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.
papers.journal: Journal of Clinical Virology and Translational Research

analysis.summary_en: This rapid review examines healthcare workers' (HCWs) preparedness for monkeypox (Mpox) pandemic response in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). The review highlights that only 46.8% of HCWs have adequate knowledge about Mpox, despite its high case fatality rate in the region. Barriers to preparedness include reliance on social media for information and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention are associated with higher knowledge levels, but these attitudes do not translate into clinical preparedness, indicating an intention-action gap. The review underscores the need for peer-reviewed information sources and a structured One Health training framework to address these gaps. The findings suggest that targeted training and policy interventions are essential to improve HCW readiness for Mpox outbreaks in SSA.

papers.title: A comparative analysis of cell death signalling in RNA and DNA virus infections and potential inhibitory strategies
papers.abstract: The recent COVID-19 pandemic and the epidemic outbreak of Mpox have demonstrated that viruses, despite their apparently simple structure, are sophisticated microorganisms that have evolved complicated pro-survival mechanisms. Their potential to manipulate cell death pathways can affect and determine the outcome of the infection cycle and the host's immune response. RNA viruses typically display a more acute and aggressive nature, as they often promote cell death. In this way, they proliferate and release their virions to infect adjacent cells and perpetuate their life cycle. Common consequences of RNA virus infection include hyperinflammatory responses in hosts, typically leading in damage to the epithelial barrier. Conversely, DNA viruses modulate these pathways to sustain a balance between the lytic cycle, during which they replicate, and latency, wherein they remain inactive until an appropriate stimulus triggers reactivation. papers.title: Metagenomic Description of the Feline Oral Microbiome
papers.abstract: Abstract The domestic cat oral microbiome constitutes an important microecosystem for both feline and public health, but integrated data on bacteria and viruses at the national level are few. The present work shows that the feline oral microbiome is essentially a separate ecosystem guided above all by geography and climate, with husbandry adding more subtle control. An OAPGC has been built—a national list of 443 prokaryotic of the 969 high-quality viral genomes studied, the bacteriome seems to be largely occupied by Pseudomonadota, Bacillota, or Bacteroidota, with > 34%of species as uncultivated lineages. The virome is mostly Caudoviricetes -based, and almost half its viruses are unclassified, an indication of great novelty in this context. Functionally, the majority of temperate phages appear to change frequently between lytic and lysogenic cycles,a tight regulation of bacterial homeostasis matched to environmental fluctuations. Of particular interest is the fact that monkeypox virus failed to appear in any of the 1, 454 tested samples—cats are not now reservoirs or vectors. Taken together, these results reveal great geographic variation, massive microbial“dark matter,”and vital viral control mechanisms. They set out a nation-wide baseline for companion animal oral microbiomes and thus help to evaluate feline pathogenesis, anticipate spillover into humans, and implement“One Health”-based approaches.
